facts.text: Ravens is a collection of simulated tasks in PyBullet for learning vision-based robotic manipulation, with a Gym-like API
Environment subclasses gym.Env and its docstring calls it an OpenAI Gym-style environment class
The observation space is a Dict of color and depth Tuples, with color boxes 0 to 255 and depth boxes 0.0 to 20.0 for each RealSenseD415 camera
The default camera configuration has three RealSenseD415 entries with 480 by 640 images
The action space is a Dict with pose0 and pose1, each a Tuple of the position box and a four-value box in -1.0 to 1.0
The position box has low [0.25, -0.5, 0.] and high [0.75, 0.5, 0.28]
Environment.seed(seed) installs a numpy RandomState in _random and returns the seed
Environment.reset() rebuilds the PyBullet scene, resets the task and returns the observation of a first step
Environment.step(action) executes a task primitive and returns the (obs, reward, done, info) tuple; a timed-out primitive also returns done True
Environment.close() unloads the EGL plugin and disconnects the PyBullet client
The PyBullet physics time step is 1./hz
The hz parameter of the Environment constructor defaults to 240

determinism.notes: Environment.seed() only seeds the camera-noise generator (environment.py:175-177) and the default camera configuration has noise disabled (cameras.py:41-73); task resets draw from the global numpy RNG, so this package makes no seed-replay claim for the upstream model.  The fake does repeat a trajectory for a given seed, but that is test data and not a device guarantee.

gaps: the timestep is the upstream constructor default hz=240 (environment.py:50, :138); hz is an option and a deployment can change it, so the published timestep is not a bound of the environment
the fake backend does not run PyBullet and models no contacts, actuator dynamics, grasp physics, task rewards or terminal conditions; it returns a constant reward without a terminal condition
the fake returns placeholder RGB-D arrays for the three cameras, smaller than the upstream RealSenseD415 480 by 640 color and depth images (cameras.py:27-28, :41-73); the image content is a stand-in
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, and one tick advances only the bridge's step counter, not the modelled physics timestep
the bridge derives no per-element limits for the Tuple pose actions (simulation-only residual): the position and rotation boxes of environment.py:89-103 are not enforced by the step input schema
the fake was not compared with the upstream environment and no upstream run was made; the clone needs the PyBullet stack and its asset tree, which the gate cannot import
no physical device is modelled and no hardware backend exists for this simulator
snapshot and restore are not offered: Environment exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime's software latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset clears it; no native stop method exists in a simulated Environment, and the state stays readable
